name: Nottuln (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nottuln (Saint Martin on horseback on red).
history: Municipal flag of Nottuln; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Nottuln arms — Saint Martin on red
